methods.label: Subtract the polynomials
methods.explanation: \(A-B=2x^2-x-(x^2+3x-1)=2x^2-x-x^2-3x+1=x^2-4x+1\). Note that the sign before the parentheses is negative, so \(-1\) must become \(+1\).
